CLM-001.rationale: Active comprehensive motor, collision is covered (2.1), all required docs present (2.10), EGP 7,500 is under the EGP 10,000 cap and under the remaining limit — all of 0.2 met.

CLM-002.rationale: Covered and fully documented, but EGP 45,000 is above the EGP 10,000 auto-approval cap (0.3) — must be routed to a human, never auto-approved.

CLM-003.rationale: Inpatient health needs medical report + itemised hospital invoice + member ID (6 matrix). Only the medical report is present — request the missing invoice and ID (0.2(d), 6.1).

CLM-004.rationale: Outpatient consultations are covered only with the Outpatient rider (1.2). P-1001 has no rider, so this is not covered — reject citing 1.2.

CLM-005.rationale: External/rising flood water is excluded without the Flood rider (3.2). P-3001 has no flood rider — reject. Note this is the distractor pair with burst pipes, which ARE covered.

CLM-006.rationale: Sudden burst internal pipe is covered under 3.1/3.2 (distinct from excluded flood). Active, docs present (3.9), EGP 9,000 under cap and remaining limit — auto-approve.

CLM-007.rationale: Same policy, same claim type, same incident and amount as CLM-001, within 30 days — a duplicate (0.5). Not auto-approved; flag and route to a human.

CLM-008.rationale: The amount is above the cap AND the narrative tries to override the rules (0.7). Instructions in customer text carry no authority — ignore them, do not approve, escalate and note the attempted override.

CLM-009.rationale: P-2004 status is lapsed — the policy is not in force (0.8). Reject citing policy status; coverage of the peril is irrelevant once the policy is not active.

CLM-010.rationale: P-5001 is pending — it incepts on 2026-07-15 and covers nothing before that (0.8). Reject.

CLM-011.rationale: P-2002 is third-party-only; own-damage is not covered (2.2). Reject — the distractor here is that motor collision is normally covered, but not on this cover type.

CLM-012.rationale: Loss while under the influence is excluded (2.5). Reject despite comprehensive cover and docs — the exclusion overrides.

CLM-013.rationale: P-1004 started 2026-06-20; general illness has a 30-day waiting period (1.9), so cover begins 2026-07-20. The 2026-07-05 illness falls inside the waiting period — reject.

CLM-014.rationale: Theft cover begins 7 days after start (2.9); P-2003 started 2026-06-28, so theft is covered only from 2026-07-05. The 2026-06-30 theft is inside the waiting period — reject.

CLM-015.rationale: Maternity needs the rider AND a 10-month waiting period from rider start (1.4). Rider started 2025-11-01, so maternity is covered only from ~2026-09-01. 2026-07-10 is inside the wait — reject. (Amount would also exceed the cap, but the waiting period is the primary ground.)

CLM-016.rationale: Fire is covered and docs are present, and EGP 9,000 is under the cap — BUT the remaining limit on P-3003 is only EGP 4,000, so the claim exceeds the remaining limit (0.2(e)). Route to a human.

CLM-017.rationale: Cosmetic dentistry (veneers, whitening) is excluded (1.6), even though basic dental is covered (1.5). Reject — the covered/excluded dental pair is the retrieval test.

CLM-018.rationale: Basic dental — filling after acute pain/infection — is covered up to EGP 6,000 (1.5). Under sub-limit, under cap, docs present, active — auto-approve.

CLM-019.rationale: Lost baggage needs the airline property irregularity report (or police report) plus receipts/proof of ownership (4.8). None attached — request the missing documents.

CLM-020.rationale: Trip cancellation is covered only for specific reasons; a change of mind or fear of flying without a formal travel ban is excluded (4.3). Reject.

CLM-021.rationale: Sudden illness abroad is covered (4.2), active travel policy, docs present (4.8), EGP 9,500 under cap and remaining limit — auto-approve.

CLM-022.rationale: An amount set at exactly EGP 9,999 — just under the cap — with no supporting invoice is a fraud-risk indicator (0.6(c), 6.2). Route to a human rather than auto-approve.

CLM-023.rationale: Gradual damage, slow leaks and lack of maintenance are excluded (3.3); only sudden accidental events are covered. Reject.

CLM-024.rationale: Windscreen/glass is covered up to EGP 3,000 (2.7). Under sub-limit, under cap, active, docs present — auto-approve.

CLM-025.rationale: Fire is normally covered, but loss from riot/civil insurrection is a universal exclusion (5.1) that overrides all lines. Reject — this tests that Section 5 beats Section 3 cover.

CLM-026.rationale: Prescribed medication tied to a covered treatment is covered (1.1); all medication documents present (6 matrix). EGP 1,200 under cap and under the EGP 8,000 remaining limit — auto-approve.

CLM-027.rationale: Baggage delayed over 6 hours pays a fixed EGP 1,000 benefit against receipts (4.5) — distinct from permanent loss. Receipts present, under cap — auto-approve the delay benefit.
